d:
The 2-mile run is one of the biggest pain points of the Army Fitness Test (AFT). Most Soldiers aren’t inherently slow… they’re just missing a few key fundamentals.
In this video, I break down 3 fixes you can apply immediately to run a faster 2-mile:
1⃣ Nutrition & hydration
2⃣ Proper running form
3⃣ Breathing technique
These small changes can make a big difference on test day without adding junk miles or overtraining.
Comment below: What part of the 2-mile hurts your time the most? What do you want help with?
